basic_details.job_title: HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCH&RC), Muzaffarpur (Bihar), part of Tata Memorial Centre, will hold a walk-in interview on Monday, 30 November 2026, between 9.00 am and 10.00 am, for 2 contract posts of Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical) at a consolidated Rs. 61,040/- PM. The posts are under an ICMR-funded oral cancer genetics project. A Master Degree in Bioinformatics or in any stream of biological Sciences or Life Sciences with minimum 55% marks is the essential qualification. Outstation candidates may attend online by emailing [email protected] by 28 November 2026,

how_to_apply: Report for the walk-in interview on Monday, 30 November 2026, between 9.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004.
Carry the bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, the original documents and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates (listed below).
Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. They should email [email protected] so that the mail is received by 28 November 2026, 3:00 PM.
Mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the resume with the Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copy of Aadhar and PAN Card in a single PDF file.
Original documents of PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Experience Certificates and Education Certificates
One set of self-attested copies of all certificates
important_instructions: Recruitment queries can be sent to the HRD Department, HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur at [email protected] and/or phone 9472377509. The notice states that the interview venue phone number is 9472377509.

content_sections.heading: About HBCH&RC
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre is a Tata Memorial Centre unit at Umanagar, Muzaffarpur, Bihar. The notice is issued by its HRD Department and signed by the Administrative Officer III (HRD). The posts are project based and are engaged on contract under the ICMR-funded project named above.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice prints no category-wise break-up of the 2 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age limit: 40 years as on date of interview. The notice prints no age relaxation. Extensive experience in analysis of cancer genomics, including analysis of next-generation sequencing (NGS) data from biological and clinical samples for whole genome/exome sequencing/transcriptomic, targeted sequencing of a limited gene panel, and establishment of an in-house bioinformatics pipeline for the same. Sound knowledge in Linux, scripting and R programming. Candidates working in academic institutions with minimum 2 years of proven experience will be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master Degree in Bioinformatics or in any stream of biological Sciences or Life Sciences with minimum 55% marks.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 61,040/- PM. The appointment is on contract and is initially for a period of six months or till the continuation of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical) vacancies are there at HBCH&RC?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Project Research Scientist- (Non-Medical) under the ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. When is the HBCH&RC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Monday, 30 November 2026, between 9.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in Bioinformatics or in any stream of biological Sciences or Life Sciences with minimum 55% marks is the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years as on date of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Research Scientist at HBCH&RC?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 61,040/- PM.

faq.question: Q6. Can outstation candidates attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes, outstation candidates may attend the interview online. They must email [email protected] by 28 November 2026, 3:00 PM with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. What should be sent with the email for an online interview?
faq.answer: The resume with Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copy of Aadhar and PAN Card, all in a single PDF file.

faq.answer: Carry bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, original PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Experience Certificates and Education Certificates, and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract. The appointment is initially for six months or till the continuation of the project, whichever is earlier.
